plan.title: Scholarship Application Summary
plan.subtitle: Overview of scholarship applications for board review.

panels.title: Total Applicants
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_applicants FROM scholarship_applicants

panels.title: Approved Applications
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS approved_count FROM scholarship_applicants WHERE Status = 'Approved'

panels.title: Applications by Category
panels.sql: SELECT Category, COUNT(*) AS count FROM scholarship_applicants GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Applications by District
panels.sql: SELECT District, COUNT(*) AS count FROM scholarship_applicants GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Top 10 Applicants by Marks
panels.sql: SELECT "Naam", "Marks %" FROM scholarship_applicants ORDER BY "Marks %" DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Monthly Application Trend
panels.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', DOB) AS application_month, COUNT(*) AS application_count FROM scholarship_applicants GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

plan.narrative: This report provides a snapshot of the scholarship application process. A total of {{p1}} applications were received. Of these, {{p2}} have been approved. The distribution of applications across categories is shown in panel 3, with the most common categories being {{p3.Category}} and {{p3.count}}. Panel 4 illustrates the geographic distribution, highlighting the districts with the highest application volume, such as {{p4.District}} and {{p4.count}}. The top 10 applicants by marks are listed in panel 5, with the highest scoring applicant, {{p5."Naam"}}, achieving a score of {{p5."Marks %"}}. Finally, panel 6 shows the monthly application trend, indicating that the highest number of applications were received in {{p6.application_month}} with {{p6.application_count}} applications.
